International human-rights organisation report (June 2025): 101 'extremism' convictions since the January 2024 Supreme Court designation (98 administrative, 3 criminal) for alleged LGBT-movement participation or symbol display, with repeat display now facing up to 4 years. 257 'gay propaganda' penalties in 2023-2024 versus 22 in 2021-2022, totalling over 63 million rubles in fines; around 20 criminal LGBT-related charges since January 2024, including publishing-house staff facing up to 12 years. Two national support groups report departure and asylum requests spiking and queer spaces closing after the designation.
